	<ResortReportHeadline>Terrific Tuesday!</ResortReportHeadline>
	<ResortReport><p>The wind has picked up ahead of some weather approaching tomorrow, but today should be another great day on the hill.&nbsp; The sky is clear apart from a few scattered high clouds, the current temp is 0.6, heading for a top of 6 degrees, and the wind is a moderate northerly.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p>The snow will be very similar to yesterday.&nbsp; There was another decent freeze overnight, so will start the day off firm before the sunny aspects soften as the day progresses.&nbsp; The groomed runs should be in good shape first up, while the sunny off-piste areas will be worth investigating once the day warms.&nbsp;</p><p>Slap it on and get out there to make the most of it!</p><p>Cheers Bill</p></ResortReport>

All aspects will be slick this morning, sunny aspects should soften for spring-like turns as the day warms, but beware of south facing and shaded slopes that will likely stay icy and pose a hazard all day.  Take care out there.  </Backcountry>
